eas_text: A civil authority has issued A REQUIRED MONTHLY TEST for the following counties or areas: Caroline; Hanover; Louisa; Orange; Spotsylvania; Fredericksburg city, VA; at 8:14 AM on AUG 21, 2013 Effective until 8:29 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A required monthly test has been issued for Caroline County, Hanover County, Louisa County, Orange County, Spotsylvania County and The City Of Fredericksburg. Tune to your local TV or radio station.
